snippet.title: Frosthaven | Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist & Follow Frosthaven on Steam: https://bit.ly/4npNR6q

We are excited to reveal the Early Access launch trailer for FROSTHAVEN, the dark fantasy tactical RPG based on the highly acclaimed board game of the same name – now available in Early Access on Steam and Epic Games Store. In celebration of bringing the beloved board game to the digital realm, FROSTHAVEN will be available for 10% off its retail price until August 7. Also, to give you the ultimate strategic board game digital adaptation experience, we have partnered with Twin Sails, publisher of the digital version of Gloomhaven, to offer a bundle that includes both FROSTHAVEN and Gloomhaven that will be available for a limited time.

Watch: https://www.youtube.com/@PlayFrosthaven
Follow: https://x.com/PlayFrosthaven  
Like: https://www.facebook.com/FrosthavenGame  
Discuss: https://discord.gg/FUNmzWVfz2
